races.name: Irish Stallion Farms European Breeders Fund Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
BANKS OF THE BOYNE more than backed up his Fairyhouse effort when runner-up at Galway 17 days ago and eased 1 lb since, he's just about the pick of the weights. Mr Montauk is a very solid opponent, with Alrashdeyah a potential improver with Oisin Murphy in the saddle.

  1. BANKS OF THE BOYNE (IRE)
  2. MR MONTAUK (IRE)
  3. ALRASHDEYAH (IRE)

races.name: Irish European Breeders Fund Median Sires Series Maiden
races.verdict:
THE PIPEMAN didn't cost much last year but showed plenty when runner-up in a 17-runner Navan maiden on debut and he can go one place better. Donnacha O'Brien's filly Coincidenza makes most appeal of the newcomers, whilst Heart of You should also prove competitive second time up.

  1. THE PIPEMAN (IRE)
  2. COINCIDENZA (IRE)
  3. HEART OF YOU (IRE)

races.name: Melbourne Cup Carnival Handicap
races.verdict:
BUNDLE OF INTEREST caught the eye when an unlucky-in-running seventh at Gowran last time and can gain compensation here off an unchanged mark to double her career tally. Neo Smart didn't enjoy the rub of the green when fourth in that contest and is next on the list, while Comfort Line and Alto Sax also need factoring into this open handicap.

  1. BUNDLE OF INTEREST (IRE)
  2. NEO SMART (IRE)
  3. COMFORT LINE (IRE)

races.name: Velo 'Official Coffee At The Curragh' Irish European Breeders Fund Maiden
races.verdict:
ZARAK PASHA can confirm recent Galway superiority over Thomas Chippendale and get off the mark at the third time of asking. Several of the newcomers hold Group entries and would enter the reckoning if the betting speaks in their favour.

  1. ZARAK PASHA (IRE)
  2. THOMAS CHIPPENDALE (IRE)
  3. ANGELS HAVE WINGS (IRE)

races.name: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Handicap
races.verdict:
Lots with chances but BLACKJACK HILLS rates just the pick of the weights and wasn't seen to ideal effect from a wide draw when eighth at Galway last time so gets the vote. Youcansaythatagain could emerge as the main danger now going into handicaps ahead of Guinelot and Thyer.

  1. BLACKJACK HILLS (IRE)
  2. YOUCANSAYTHATAGAIN (IRE)
  3. GUINELOT (FR)

races.name: Newbridge Silverware Royal Whip Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
Not only is A BOY NAMED SUSIE's runner-up effort in the Eclipse a different level to these but he also receives weight from the 4-y-os, so he really should make no mistake down in grade. A literal reading of Omni Man's effort in the Ballyroan Stakes at Leopardstown suggests he's the prudent forecast option.

  1. A BOY NAMED SUSIE (IRE)
  2. OMNI MAN (IRE)
  3. COWARDOFTHECOUNTY (IRE)

races.name: William Hill Irish European Breeders Fund Juvenile Sprint Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
The strength of ARMOR SUPREME's Royal Ascot form narrowly gives her the edge over unexposed Concorde Landed. Several of the others should have more to offer, including Brazilian Diva and Grayrobin.

  1. ARMOR SUPREME (IRE)
  2. CONCORDE LANDED (IRE)
  3. BRAZILIAN DIVA (IRE)

races.name: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Handicap
races.verdict:
BOLD OPTIMIST was back to his best when runner-up at Naas last time and a repeat of that effort should see him go close. C&D specialist Mary Shoelaces beat Harry's Hill here last month and both should be in the mix again.

  1. BOLD OPTIMIST (IRE)
  2. MARY SHOELACES (IRE)
  3. HARRY'S HILL

races.name: Enter ITV7 For Free EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
VARZI is also declared to run at Thirsk on Friday evening but will set a good standard based on his York second if taking up this engagement. Princeland would make most appeal in his absence given the Crisfords' fine record with juveniles this year.

  1. VARZI (IRE)
  2. PRINCELAND (IRE)
  3. MAGIC HARRY (FR)

races.name: Sky Bet For The Fans Fillies' Handicap
races.verdict:
Boasting a progressive profile in maiden/novice company, SI GRASS shaped better than the distance beaten suggests when eighth on her return/handicap debut at Goodwood 3 weeks ago, her early keenness/lack of a recent run telling late on. Hailing from a useful family and open to further improvement, she's fancied to build on the promise of that run. Nottingham scorer Luna Celeste may offer chief resistance along with Darzah.

  1. SI GRASS (IRE)
  2. LUNA CELESTE (IRE)
  3. DARZAH

races.name: EBF Sky Bet Club Flying Fillies' Stakes (Fillies And Mares' Listed)
races.verdict:
Last month's Group 3 Summer Stakes at York looks solid form so AMERICA QUEEN and Royal Fixation may be the pair to focus on. The former finished 1¼ lengths ahead of Karl Burke's charge on that occasion and, from a handy draw for a prominent racer, is taken to confirm that superiority. The returning Arabian Dusk and last year's runner-up Magic Basma are others likely to be in the shake-up.

  1. AMERICA QUEEN (IRE)
  2. ROYAL FIXATION
  3. ARABIAN DUSK

races.name: Sky Bet Price Boosts Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
He may well be proving expensive to follow but HIGH DEGREE has put up several good efforts in defeat this season and, with the possibility of being able to dominate this in first-time headgear, William Haggas' 4-y-o gets the nod. His main threat may emerge from Jez Bomb, who has won 2 of his last 3 starts here in recent weeks, while Shoof Baeed looks an interesting handicap debutant on paper, so he completes the shortlist.

  1. HIGH DEGREE
  2. JEZ BOMB
  3. SHOOF BAEED

races.name: Sky Bet Build A Bet Handicap
races.verdict:
KYLIAN and Fluorescence make plenty of appeal in a race that should suit both, with Robert Cowell's well-treated sprinter narrowly shading the vote. Vintage Clarets is lurking on a dangerous mark but perhaps doesn't have the ideal draw or ground conditions.

  1. KYLIAN (IRE)
  2. FLUORESCENCE
  3. VINTAGE CLARETS

races.name: Sky Bet Extra Places Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
Jim Goldie's C&D scorer LETSBEFRANK rates the pick of the weights and now stepping back up considerably in trip looks the way to go trying to land another Sunday Series pot. Both Campeona (second choice) and Sixty Plus bid for four-timers and rate big threats though, while the consistent Pole Star is another to consider in an intriguing handicap.

  1. LETSBEFRANK (IRE)
  2. CAMPEONA
  3. SIXTY PLUS (IRE)

races.name: Sky Bet Proud To Support Young Lives Vs Cancer Handicap
races.verdict:
VEBLEN GOOD won over C&D back in April and confirmed himself a useful sprinter with a fine fourth in a big-field at York last time. He's fancied to capitalise on this drop in grade and deny Alfa Whiteburd a fourth consecutive win. Yes I'm Mali completes the 1-2-3.

  1. VEBLEN GOOD (IRE)
  2. ALFA WHITEBURD (IRE)
  3. YES I'M MALI

races.name: Newark Advertiser Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
CLIFF DANGER hasn’t set the world alight in 4 outings to date, but he has more than once left the impression there is better to come, including on handicap debut last time. This step up in trip should suit and he looks worth chancing. Yaa Min and Wonder are reliable sorts and head a lengthy list of potential dangers.

  1. CLIFF DANGER
  2. YAA MIN
  3. WONDER

races.name: Fraser Plus Designer Outlet East Midlands Handicap
races.verdict:
The booking of Billy Loughnane for TARDAFF catches the eye and she might be worth chancing, with confidence in her prospects increased should the betting vibes be strong. Ribston Pippin has a solid C&D record and can shrug aside a couple of lesser efforts on turf and provide the chief threat ahead of Love You More and Mercurius Power.

  1. TARDAFF
  2. RIBSTON PIPPIN (IRE)
  3. LOVE YOU MORE

races.name: LNAA Critical Care Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
In keeping with his pedigree, PALLADAS looked every inch a smart prospect when comfortably seeing off a couple of useful opponents starting out at Kempton in January. His subsequent absence is no real concern given connections and he's expected to successfully concede weight all round. Regal Desire is at the other end of the buying spectrum but she has displayed ability both starts, while Assiri Heights could be a different proposition this time.

  1. PALLADAS
  2. REGAL DESIRE (FR)
  3. ASSIRI HEIGHTS (IRE)

races.name: LNAA Critical Care Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This looks a good opportunity for PROSPERITY to make it 2-2 under a penalty. If there's one to spoil the party, it'll probably be interesting newcomer Al Jolson.

  1. PROSPERITY
  2. AL JOLSON
  3. SOTTO IL SASSO (IRE)

races.name: Coopers Marquees Handicap
races.verdict:
A few with chances but it could pay to side with VALVANO to return in style after a break and capitalise on a handy-looking mark for his in-form yard. Dual C&D winner Shiplake could emerge as the main danger now back over 7f, although Brian Toomey's new recruit Tina's Indian is worth a market check with Billy Loughnane in the saddle.

  1. VALVANO (IRE)
  2. SHIPLAKE (IRE)
  3. TINA'S INDIAN (IRE)

races.name: Grace & Dotty Maiden Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SPACE PARTY built on an encouraging debut effort when finishing a good second in a Windsor maiden back in the spring and, appealing as the type to progress further, he earns the vote to go one place better. Storm Force has been absent since last spring but firmly appeals as the type to do better as a 3-y-o having been gelded, with similar comments applying to Poison Arrow. Iron Dome and Persian Gate are appealing newcomers and require a market check.

  1. SPACE PARTY (IRE)
  2. STORM FORCE (IRE)
  3. POISON ARROW (IRE)

races.name: Grace & Dotty Maiden Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
Amo Racing landed the second division of this maiden 12 months ago and they can repeat that feat with BLACK ORCHID, who is unlikely to live up to her smart pedigree, but Richard & Peter Fahey's filly has shown plenty of promise with a couple of runner-up efforts. She gets the nod over Yordan, who ran a cracker when second on his belated debut at Leicester last month and should improve. Oddjob can edge out Cosmic Girl for minor honours.

  1. BLACK ORCHID
  2. YORDAN (IRE)
  3. ODDJOB (IRE)

races.name: GB Civil Engineering Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
MASSIMO BLUE shaped better than his recent Wolverhampton third suggests, having been caught wide and further back than ideal, and looks worth siding with in a tight affair starting out for a new yard. Toptime has 3 course wins and has returned in good form this year, so must be respected, while Torfrida is well treated on the pick of her efforts and should be suited by this return to 6f.

  1. MASSIMO BLUE
  2. TOPTIME
  3. TORFRIDA

races.name: IFAHR Cup Handicap Stakes (0-95) - Arab Race
Tramore Directors Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
This could be dominated by the powerful yards, with Willie Mullins' SPEED FOR FUN fancied to get the better of hurdling debutants Ballybollen and Ivatt.

  1. SPEED FOR FUN (FR)
  2. BALLYBOLLEN
  3. IVATT

races.name: Frank Gillane Memorial Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
Back on the same mark as when successful in this corresponding race 12 months ago, SURVIVING MURMANSK narrowly gets the vote ahead of recent Cork winner Ina Mina. If they go too hard, Annie's Angel could be the beneficiary, while Lanzhou also appeals following a better effort here on Thursday.

  1. SURVIVING MURMANSK (IRE)
  2. INA MINA
  3. ANNIE'S ANGEL (IRE)

races.name: Frank King Memorial Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
This will probably go to a hurdling debutant, with Willie Mullins-trained mare LADY LENA fancied to overcome Something Fabulous.

  1. LADY LENA (IRE)
  2. SOMETHING FABULOUS (IRE)
  3. MARKET READY (IRE)

races.name: Victoria House Tramore Mares Beginners Chase
races.verdict:
Willie Mullins looks to hold the key to this maiden chase. LA NOTE VERTE was narrowly behind reopposing stablemate Future Prospect over a much shorter trip at Wexford last month but looks open to further progress and is taken to come out on top this time.

  1. LA NOTE VERTE
  2. FUTURE PROSPECT (IRE)
  3. MISS FOURIE (IRE)

races.name: McCarthy's Irish Bar Lexington Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
A chance is taken on A SNOW WHITE PARK, who ran well at this course earlier in the season and should be suited by the step back up in trip. Pourquoi Poi is still relatively unexposed after just a couple of runs in this sphere and rates the main danger, while Intense Approach is well treated if able to keep any jumping mistakes to a minimum.

  1. A SNOW WHITE PARK (IRE)
  2. POURQUOI POI (IRE)
  3. INTENSE APPROACH

races.name: Heinz Pollmeier Memorial Handicap Chase (0-100)
races.verdict:
BOSSING IT was among the best of these over hurdles and is bred to be even better in this sphere, so she looks worth siding with to make a successful chasing debut. Presenting Lad and last year’s winner Itsalonglongroad are well treated on the pick of their efforts and rate the main dangers.

  1. BOSSING IT (IRE)
  2. PRESENTING LAD (IRE)
  3. ITSALONGLONGROAD

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Flat Race
races.verdict:
MYLUCKYMAKER produced her best effort to date when second at Clonmel in April and, with the winner that day having tasted success again since, she could be the way to go starting out for a new stable going better than for a while. Village Dream appeals as a likely improver from her debut effort and is a big threat, ahead of The Two Mary's.

  1. MYLUCKYMAKER (IRE)
  2. VILLAGE DREAM (IRE)
  3. THE TWO MARY'S (IRE)
